title: DonutNetwork
description: A small rush-designed minigame network made to improve your skills.
body:
*DonutNetwork.eu is a small rush-designed Minecraft minigame server to improve your skills.*

__**Our Gamemodes:**__

**MLG-Rush**: One of the best modes to learn how to reduce. You can play 1v1 or 1v1v1v1, with your own *custom* knockback settings.

**BuildFFA**: A PvP gamemode where you earn elo by killing others.

**Fastbuilder**: Here is your goal to bridge so fast as possible to the other island.

**Clutches**: In this game you can select hits and try to do a clutch with the blocks, but you can also PvP their.

Join now using the IP: `donutnetwork.eu`
